functions.name: HAL_DAC_Init

params.name: hdac
params.descEn: pointer to a DAC_HandleTypeDef structure that contains the configuration information for the specified DAC.

functions.briefEn: Initialize the DAC peripheral according to the specified parameters in the DAC_InitStruct and initialize the associated handle.
functions.briefZh: 按 InitTypeDef 中的参数初始化 DAC，并完成状态机初始化。

functions.name: HAL_DAC_DeInit

params.name: hdac

functions.briefEn: Deinitialize the DAC peripheral registers to their default reset values.
functions.briefZh: 把 DAC 的寄存器恢复成复位默认值，并调用 MspDeInit 释放底层资源。

params.name: hdac

functions.name: HAL_DAC_Start_DMA
functions.prototype: HAL_StatusTypeDef HAL_DAC_Start_DMA(DAC_HandleTypeDef *hdac, uint32_t Channel, const uint32_t *pData, uint32_t Length, uint32_t Alignment);

params.name: hdac
params.descEn: pointer to a DAC_HandleTypeDef structure that contains the configuration information for the specified DAC.

params.name: Channel
params.descEn: The selected DAC channel. This parameter can be one of the following values:
params.descZh: DAC 通道：DAC_CHANNEL_1 或 DAC_CHANNEL_2（双通道型号才有 2）。

params.name: pData
params.descEn: The source Buffer address.
params.descZh: 数据缓冲区指针。发送用 const uint8_t*（不修改数据），接收用 uint8_t*。缓冲区必须在传输期间保持有效——中断/DMA 方式下函数会立刻返回，此时还不能改动这个缓冲区。

params.name: Length
params.descEn: The length of data to be transferred from memory to DAC peripheral
params.descZh: DMA 方式输出的数据个数（每个数据项对应一次 DAC 转换）。

params.name: Alignment
params.descEn: Specifies the data alignment for DAC channel. This parameter can be one of the following values:
params.descZh: 数据对齐方式：DAC_ALIGN_12B_R（12 位右对齐，最常用）、12B_L、8B_R。

functions.briefEn: Enables DAC and starts conversion of channel.
functions.briefZh: 以 DMA 方式启动 DAC，搬运过程不占用 CPU。

functions.name: HAL_DAC_Stop_DMA

params.name: hdac
params.descEn: pointer to a DAC_HandleTypeDef structure that contains the configuration information for the specified DAC.

params.name: Channel
params.descEn: The selected DAC channel. This parameter can be one of the following values:
params.descZh: DAC 通道：DAC_CHANNEL_1 或 DAC_CHANNEL_2（双通道型号才有 2）。

functions.briefEn: Disables DAC and stop conversion of channel.
functions.briefZh: 停止 DAC 的 DMA 方式运行，并关闭 DMA 通道。

functions.name: HAL_DAC_IRQHandler

params.name: hdac
params.descEn: pointer to a DAC_HandleTypeDef structure that contains the configuration information for the specified DAC.

functions.briefEn: Handles DAC interrupt request This function uses the interruption of DMA underrun.
functions.briefZh: DAC 的中断统一入口。在 stm32f1xx_it.c 的对应 IRQHandler 里调用，内部会清标志并分派到各回调。

functions.name: HAL_DAC_RegisterCallback

params.name: hdac
params.descEn: DAC handle

params.name: CallbackID
params.descEn: ID of the callback to be registered This parameter can be one of the following values:
params.descZh: 回调事件的编号，取 HAL_<外设>_CallbackIDTypeDef 里的枚举值（如 HAL_UART_TX_COMPLETE_CB_ID）。

params.name: pCallback
params.descEn: pointer to the Callback function
params.descZh: 回调函数指针。签名必须与 HAL 里定义的 typedef 完全一致，否则编译能过但调用时会崩溃。

functions.briefEn: Register a User DAC Callback To be used instead of the weak (overridden) predefined callback
functions.briefZh: 为 DAC 注册指定事件的回调，替代默认的 __weak 空实现。
remarks: The HAL_DAC_RegisterCallback() may be called before HAL_DAC_Init() in HAL_DAC_STATE_RESET to register callbacks for HAL_DAC_MSPINIT_CB_ID and HAL_DAC_MSPDEINIT_CB_ID

functions.name: HAL_DAC_UnRegisterCallback

params.name: hdac
params.descEn: DAC handle

params.name: CallbackID
params.descEn: ID of the callback to be unregistered This parameter can be one of the following values:
params.descZh: 回调事件的编号，取 HAL_<外设>_CallbackIDTypeDef 里的枚举值（如 HAL_UART_TX_COMPLETE_CB_ID）。

functions.briefEn: Unregister a User DAC Callback DAC Callback is redirected to the weak (overridden) predefined callback
functions.briefZh: 注销 DAC 已注册的回调，恢复成默认的 __weak 空实现。
remarks: The HAL_DAC_UnRegisterCallback() may be called before HAL_DAC_Init() in HAL_DAC_STATE_RESET to un-register callbacks for HAL_DAC_MSPINIT_CB_ID and HAL_DAC_MSPDEINIT_CB_ID

functions.name: HAL_DACEx_TriangleWaveGenerate

params.name: hdac
params.descEn: pointer to a DAC_HandleTypeDef structure that contains the configuration information for the specified DAC.

params.name: Channel
params.descEn: The selected DAC channel. This parameter can be one of the following values:
params.descZh: DAC 通道：DAC_CHANNEL_1 或 DAC_CHANNEL_2（双通道型号才有 2）。

params.name: Amplitude
params.descEn: Select max triangle amplitude. This parameter can be one of the following values:
params.descZh: 波形幅度（DAC_TRIANGLE_AMPLITUDE_1 ~ _4095），决定三角波/噪声波的峰值偏移量。

functions.briefEn: Enable or disable the selected DAC channel wave generation.
functions.briefZh: 让 DAC 通道自动生成三角波，只需设定最大幅度，波形由硬件推演，不占用 CPU。

params.name: hdac

functions.name: HAL_DACEx_DualSetValue
functions.prototype: HAL_StatusTypeDef HAL_DACEx_DualSetValue(DAC_HandleTypeDef *hdac, uint32_t Alignment, uint32_t Data1, uint32_t Data2);

params.name: hdac
params.descEn: pointer to a DAC_HandleTypeDef structure that contains the configuration information for the specified DAC.

params.name: Alignment
params.descEn: Specifies the data alignment for dual channel DAC. This parameter can be one of the following values: DAC_ALIGN_8B_R: 8bit right data alignment selected DAC_ALIGN_12B_L: 12bit left data alignment selected DAC_ALIGN_12B_R: 12bit right data alignment selected
params.descZh: 数据对齐方式：DAC_ALIGN_12B_R（12 位右对齐，最常用）、12B_L、8B_R。

params.name: Data1
params.descEn: Data for DAC Channel1 to be loaded in the selected data holding register.

params.name: Data2
params.descEn: Data for DAC Channel2 to be loaded in the selected data holding register.

functions.briefEn: Set the specified data holding register value for dual DAC channel.
functions.briefZh: 同时设置两个 DAC 通道的输出值（双通道模式下用，保证两路同步更新）。
remarks: In dual mode, a unique register access is required to write in both DAC channels at the same time.
